raw_segments.text: Romeo, why such is love's transgression? Griefs of mine own lie heavy in my breast,
which thou wilt propagate to have it pressed with more of thine. This love that thou hast
shown doth add more grief to too much of mine own. Love is a smoke made with a fume of sighs,
being purged, a fire sparkling in lovers' eyes, being vexed, a sea nourished with lovers'
tears. What is it else? A madness most discreet, a choking gall, and a preserving sweet. Farewell,
